values: Contract under legal dispute - do not contact until resolved
Agency handling renewal directly - do not send duplicate reminder

收件人：marketing@company.example.com
日期：2026-01-27T10:00:00Z
主题：Influencer Renewal Process Update
Team,

Updated renewal process for January:

1. Each reminder email MUST include the campaign batch code RENEW-BATCH-449 for tracking purposes.
2. Include the influencer name and their contract end date in each email.
3. For influencers with contract value >= $5000, CC partnerships-lead@company.example.com on the reminder.

Best,
Partnerships Lead"}
